title: ICAI Reopens CA Final Nov 2026 Exam Application Window: Apply Now!
content:
# ICAI Reopens CA Final Nov 2026 Exam Application Window: Apply Now!

Ek important update hai. The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ne CA Final November 2026 Examination ke liye application window phir se open karne ka announce kiya hai. Yeh उन candidates ke liye ek one-time opportunity hai jo pehle apply nahi kar paaye the.

*   **New Application Window:** Eligible candidates ab 1st August 2026 (subah 11:00 baje se) se 5th August 2026 (raat 11:59 baje tak) apply kar sakte hain.
*   **Reason for Reopening:** This facility has been introduced for eligible candidates who might have missed the earlier deadline, possibly due to confusion over the revised examination cycle.
*   **Previous Schedule:** Pehle, application process 6th July 2026 ko start hua tha. Bina late fee ke apply karne ki last date 19th July 2026 thi, aur late fee ke saath 22nd July 2026 tak forms accept kiye गए थे.
*   **How to Apply:** Candidates ICAI ke e-services portal (icai.org) par online application submit kar sakte hain.
*   **Important Note:** ICAI ne apni official X (formerly Twitter) handle par yeh announcement ki hai aur kaha hai ki detailed announcement jaldi hi publish hogi. Candidates ko salaah di jaati hai ki woh last date ka wait na karein aur jald se jald apna form submit karein.
